what_it_shows: Drone aerial over the Subic Bay marina: rows of docked yachts and boats, with the red-roofed clubhouse building and hills behind.
notes: YouTube channel 'Wilrae Aerial Impressions'. Source has a sepia film grade and sprocket-hole edges. The cut is desaturated (saturation 0.25), brightened slightly, and cropped 10% from each side. The 'WILRAE AERIAL' logo card sits around 70s, outside the cut. Result is grey and a little dim; re-grade before use if brighter colour is wanted.
